caveats.en: Arturia says none of its drivers (audio interfaces, controllers, synths) support Windows on Arm; the installer stops with 'The Current system is not supported'. Its plug-ins may run under emulation but are untested.
caveats.zh-TW: Arturia 表示旗下所有驅動程式（錄音介面、控制器、合成器）都不支援 Windows on Arm，安裝程式會顯示「The Current system is not supported」。外掛在模擬下或許能跑，但未經測試。

evidence.title: Arturia: Windows 11 compatibility, drivers not compatible with Windows on Arm
